newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Espirito Santo to release new coffee figure.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Espirito Santo to release new coffee figure.

text.p: Brazil's Espirito Santo state agricultural secretariat is to release on April 14 its second estimate for the state's coffee crop, said the agronomist responsible for the secretariat's coffee estimates.
In December, the secretariat forecast Espirito Santo would produce 3.59 million 60-kg bags coffee in 1997/98, down 27.69 percent from 4.97 million bags in 1996/97.

"I think the new figure will be around about the same as in December," said Marcos Moulin. "There is a possibility of a reduction in the arabica forecast and conillon should be more or less the same," he added.

In November, the secretariat put future arabica coffee output at 1.06 million bags, down 37.17 percent from 1.69 million in 1996/97. Conillon production was forecast to drop 22.81 percent to 2.53 million from a 1996/97 crop of 3.29 million bags.
Other recent trade estimates for the state have been between 3.4 million and 4.15 million bags. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
